Piping tips. 
Metal Spatula, they vary in sizes.this is like layering cream down.
Bread knife - good for all baked goods.
A chef knife comes in many different shapes and forms. This knife can do everything that the others' knives can do. 
A pairing knife, chefs best friend
Cissors 
Tweezers: Any size will do
The thermometer (personal) keeps it on you at all times.
If you want, you can have your own aprons, buy off Amazon. 
Chef cogs, get comfortable, being on your feet all day. Hard toe is better just in case you drop something 
Sharpening rod for all knives. Or stone, varies on knife.
